budget_items.topic: FY2017 capital requests and recommended total
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital requests from all departments for FY2017 totaled $1.6 million, and the CPC recommends funding 12 projects at a stated total cost.
budget_items.quote: capital requests for fy2017 from all departments totaled $1.6 million. the committee recommends funding 12 projects, at a total cost of $781,975.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A table lists each recommended FY2017 project with its cost and running total; the final running total printed in the table differs from the text total.
budget_items.quote: the following table gives details of the projects recommended for funding.

budget_items.topic: Local aid and capital funding range
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Based on governor's budget local aid amounts, Kerry estimates the Town will have between $600,000 and $700,000 for capital improvements; the lower end funds the first ten projects, the higher end includes THMS asbestos abatement.
budget_items.quote: kerry estimates that the town will have between $600,000 and $700,000 to fund capital improvements.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The THMS project spans several years and would consume the whole capital budget over several years, so it is a candidate for a funding source outside the capital budget.
budget_items.quote: this project spans several years and costs enough that funding it would consume all the capital budget over several years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Jay said the $70,000 pick-up costs about twice the price of similar trucks; Dennis said the quotation included a 5% price escalator for a 2017 purchase.
budget_items.quote: jay pointed out that, at $70,000 this pick-up costs about twice as much as the price of similar pick-up trucks.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Governor's budget would fund Chapter 70 at a per-student amount; the legislature may set different education priorities.
budget_items.quote: in this budget chapter 70 funding would be $20 per student.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Governor's budget increases UGGA by $42,000, but the account was cut by around $300,000 in FY2006 or FY2007 and remains below its level ten years ago.
budget_items.quote: but this account was cut by around $300,000 in fy2006 or fy2007, so even with the $42,000 increase ugga remains below

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town health insurance costs for most employees will likely rise at the high end of the allowable increase, partly offset by lower costs for retirees aged 65+.
budget_items.quote: town health insurance costs for most employees will likely increase on the high end

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No financing of capital purchases is planned for FY17 to limit debt service costs.
budget_items.quote: there will be no financing of capital purchases in fy17 as the town needs to limit

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Refinancing two callable bond issues lowered interest rates and will save the Town a stated amount per year and in total over the nine-year debt service period.
budget_items.quote: which in turn will save the town $20,000 per year or $180,000 in total over the nine-year debt service period.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The rating agency reported debt service above the 3% of revenues in the financial policy; the Chair said the policy means 3% of the Town's budget.
budget_items.quote: the financial policy states that debt service expenses will not exceed three percent of the town's budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Property taxes, meals tax and ambulance receipts are above budget; snow and ice costs are more manageable, and a FY17 deficit may not need to be made up.
budget_items.quote: the q2 budget update on revenues is positive: property taxes, meals tax, and ambulance receipts are above budget

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The snow and ice removal budget was increased to a stated FY 2017 amount; a stated amount had been spent through the prior week, not counting unbilled private contractor invoices.
budget_items.quote: the town increased the snow and ice removal budget to $275,000 in fy 2017.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Concern was raised about how to spend any remaining money in the contingency account for the new school construction project.
budget_items.quote: that may remain in the contingency account associated with the new school construction project.
